issue.title: Stage ranker 16 ms perf assertion flakes under parallel npm test load
issue.description:
Repo: bob-plugins (linked), master 9c271e1. The test's own body was last changed in da7cce4.

- `npm test` failed in 2 of 2 full-suite runs during the bob-cli-3v landing. One measured 16.17 ms with `cargo test` running at the same time. The other measured 28.57 ms with the host at load average ~8.9 on 16 cores. Everything else passed (1575/1576).
- `node --test scripts/test-navigation-dependencies-stage.cjs` passed on its own (10.34 ms, 62/62).
- bob-cli-3v.2 saw the same thing earlier: 16.03 ms in the full suite, 6 ms on its own, in a file it did not touch. bob-cli-3v.5 and bob-cli-3v.6 later got green full-suite runs.

Root cause: the test times one cold `dependencyStageRank(pool, "synthetic cash")` call with `process.hrtime` and asserts it is under 16 ms. `node --test` runs the test files in parallel, so JIT warm-up and CPU contention from other files and other agents decide the result. The ranker code itself is not the cause. Fix idea: warm the ranker up first, then take the min or median of several runs. Or move the timing budget behind an opt-in perf env var so normal `npm test` checks only correctness.

issue.creation_reason: Found while landing epic bob-cli-3v (also seen by phase bob-cli-3v.2). This load-sensitive timing assertion turns the bob-plugins npm test gate red, so landings have to rerun it to prove nothing broke.

evidence.note: Proposed by bob-cli-46.4 note #1: stage-ranker 16 ms assertion failed twice in full npm test runs (19.75 ms and 29.20 ms), then its isolated run passed. Its changes only migrated caller comments and a notice. Land audit confirms the timing test and classifier were untouched by the canonical-name commit 0e6620a; this is the same pre-existing load-sensitive timing assertion, not a failure caused by bob-cli-46. No fresh timing failure run claimed by this lander.

Independent reports from epic bob-cli-47 (bob-plugins source split): bob-cli-47.1 saw the clean base c3349aa fail twice at scripts/test-navigation-dependencies-stage.cjs:1051 (20.41 ms, 16.45 ms vs 16 ms); bob-cli-47.2 saw 20.45 ms once in a post-split full suite (11.87 ms isolated); bob-cli-47.3 saw 18.23/26.93 ms and 26.70/35.06 ms in full-suite runs while isolated reruns passed (7.48 ms). Same cold single-call hrtime assertion under parallel node --test load; the split did not touch the test or the ranker. The bob-cli-47 land run's full npm test passed 1764/1764.

Proposed by bob-cli-48.2 (note #1), bob-cli-48.4 (note #1), and bob-cli-48.5 (note #1): scripts/test-navigation-dependencies-stage.cjs stage-ranker 16 ms budget failed in full npm test at 29.98 ms, 20.81/26.68 ms, and 19.43 ms, while isolated runs passed (14.48 ms, 9.66 ms). None of those phases touched the ranker or the test (cycler API v2, ledger checklist tiers, nav PRE/POST walk). The bob-cli-48 land run's full npm test on bob-plugins 252ec0e passed 1792/1792, which fits a load-dependent flake.

Proposed by bob-cli-4f.2 note #1: first full npm test after the block-id-prompt test split failed the unchanged stage-ranker assertion at 16.62 ms; isolated navigation suite passed 61/61 on both the split tree and clean base 03f0c17, clean-base npm test passed 1809/1809, and retry on the split tree passed 1809/1809. Landing independently verified b662018 preserves all 61 navigation callback bodies/options byte-for-byte; this land run npm test passed 1809/1809 and the ranker file passed standalone. The split moved the timing test to scripts/test-navigation-dependencies-stage-entry-and-view.cjs; no new timing failure is claimed by this lander. Same cold-call/load-sensitive assertion; no duplicate task.

bob-cli-4l landing (bob-plugins 5d0a200, epic HEAD): full npm test failed only 'stage ranker filters 1,000 synthetic tasks under 16 ms' (scripts/test-navigation-dependencies-stage-entry-and-view.cjs:274) at 17-21 ms under full-suite load; the same test passed 3/3 run alone on the unchanged tree. Epic bob-cli-4l did not touch the ranker or this test.
